# SUPPORT

<sub>english · <a href="./support.es.md">castellano</a> · <a href="../readme.md">readme</a> · <a href="../contributing.md">contributing</a> · <a href="../security.md">security</a></sub>

---

focusphone is maintained by a single person in their spare time. there is no paid support
and no guaranteed response time. there is also no telemetry: a report is the only way a
problem reaches the author.

| you need | go to |
|---|---|
| to install it, or to understand a screen or setting | the [user documentation](../documentation/en/README.md), in particular the [faq](../documentation/en/users/12-faq.md) |
| to report something that does not work | a [bug report](https://github.com/rezzt-dev/focusphone-app/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| to propose an idea | a [feature request](https://github.com/rezzt-dev/focusphone-app/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| to report a vulnerability | [`security.md`](../security.md) — never a public issue |
| to know what data the app handles | [`privacy.md`](../privacy.md) |
| anything else, including licensing | `contacto@rezzt.dev` |

issues can be written in english or in spanish.

**coming from `v1.0.0-beta`?** that build was signed with a different key, so android will
not update it in place: uninstall it first, then install the latest release (see
[`security.md`](../security.md#verifying-an-apk)).
